words.tr: phrase. 上班时间；办公时间
words.ex: You can meet the teacher during office hours.
words.ex_cn: 你可以在上班时间见老师。
words.en: A period of time during which a professor or teacher is available to students for consultation, typically outside of class hours.

words.tr: phrase. 学期论文；学期报告（通常为大学课程结束时提交的学术论文）
words.ex: He wrote a term paper about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学期论文。
words.en: A term paper is a research paper written by students over an academic term, accounting for a large part of a grade.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 论文陈述；论点陈述（用于阐明文章或演讲的核心论点）
words.ex: He wrote a clear thesis statement for his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的论文写了一个清晰的主题句。
words.en: A thesis statement is a sentence that summarizes the main point or claim of an essay or research paper. It is usually found at the end of the introduction.

words.tr: n. 提议的主题；拟定的议题
words.ex: The teacher listed the proposed topics for the project.
words.ex_cn: 老师列出了该项目的提议主题。
words.en: Subjects or ideas suggested for consideration or discussion.

words.tr: v. 选择主题；挑选话题
words.ex: He is selecting a topic for his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为他的论文选择一个主题。
words.en: The act of choosing a subject for discussion or study.

words.ex: The scope of this project includes three cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的范围包括三个城市。
words.en: The range of one's perceptions, thoughts, or actions.

words.ex: He often wanders off topic during meetings.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议中经常跑题。
words.en: To start talking or thinking about something that is not related to the main subject being discussed.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: His collection of old coins is very rare.
words.ex_cn: 他收集的旧硬币非常稀有。
words.en: A collection is a group of things, often of the same type, that have been gathered together over a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 研究数据；科研资料
words.ex: The research data shows a significant increase in productivity.
words.ex_cn: 研究数据显示生产力显著提高。
words.en: Research data refers to the information collected, observed, or generated in the course of a research project.

words.ex: He is working on a research project about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他正在做一个关于气候变化的研究项目。
words.en: A research project is a detailed and careful study of a specific topic or problem, often carried out over a period of time and involving the collection and analysis of information.

words.tr: phrase. 初步提纲；预备纲要
words.ex: Before starting the project, the team created a preliminary outline to guide their work.
words.ex_cn: 在开始项目之前，团队创建了一个初步大纲来指导他们的工作。
words.en: A preliminary outline is a basic plan or summary that is prepared before the main work begins.

words.tr: phrase. 最终的提纲；最后的轮廓
words.ex: He wrote the final outline before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前写好了最终提纲。
words.en: A final, detailed plan or summary of the main points of a project or document.

words.ex: He wrote the first draft of his essay last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚写了论文的初稿。
words.en: The initial version of a piece of writing, which is usually revised and improved before being finalized.

words.tr: phrase. 草稿版本；初步版本
words.ex: He wrote a draft version of his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇论文的初稿。
words.en: An early or preliminary version of a document or plan.

words.tr: phrase. 审阅草稿版本；浏览或检查一份初稿
words.ex: He will look over a draft version before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议前会审阅一份草稿。
words.en: To examine or review a preliminary version of a document or text.

words.ex: He studied hard for the mid-term exam.
words.ex_cn: 他为期中考试努力学习。
words.en: An examination taken in the middle of an academic term.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.ex: He did revision for his math test last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚为数学考试进行了复习。
words.en: The act or process of revising; a revised or new version, as of a book or other written material.

words.tr: v. 无法做到；失败；不及格；倒闭；
words.ex: He failed to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他没能完成比赛。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

words.tr:
v. 重取；重新摄制；重考
n. 重取；重新摄制；重考
words.ex: He will retake the math test next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将重考数学考试。
words.en: To take something again, especially a photograph or a film scene, or to take control of a place again after losing it.

words.tr:
adj. 选举的；选修的；可选择的
n. 选修课程
words.ex: He voted in the elective process for mayor.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了市长的选举过程。
words.en: An elective course or subject is one that you can choose to study as part of your course, rather than one that you have to study.

words.tr: adj. 选择性的；精挑细选的；
words.ex: He is selective about what he eats.
words.ex_cn: 他对吃的东西很挑剔。
words.en: If you are selective, you choose things carefully, for example, the things that you buy or do.

words.tr: n. 鸟类课程；鸟类学课程（指关于鸟类的学术课程或研究）
words.ex: He took a bird course to relax this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这学期选了一门轻松的课程来放松。
words.en: An easy, undemanding academic course requiring little effort.

words.tr: adj. 艰难的课程；困难的进程
words.ex: Math is a hard course for many students.
words.ex_cn: 数学对许多学生来说是一门难的课程。
words.en: A difficult or challenging academic subject or program of study that requires significant effort and dedication to succeed in.

words.tr: phrase. 中级水平；中等程度；中间层次
words.ex: He is at an intermediate level in English.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平是中级。
words.en: A stage of learning or skill that is more advanced than basic but not yet advanced.

words.tr: phrase. 暑期课程；夏季学期
words.ex: Many students take extra courses during the summer session to graduate early.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生在夏季学期选修额外课程以便提前毕业。
words.en: A period during the summer months when academic courses are offered at a school or university.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.tr: phrase. 签约参加工作；签约雇用；报名
words.ex: He signed up for a job at the local factory.
words.ex_cn: 他签约参加了当地工厂的工作。
words.en: To agree to become involved in an organized activity or to join a group or organization.

words.w: sign up for a noncredit course
words.tr: v. 报名参加一门不计学分的课程
words.uk: saɪn ʌp fɔːr ə nɒnˈkredɪt kɔːs
words.us: saɪn ʌp fɔːr ə nɑːnˈkredɪt kɔːrs
words.ex: He wants to sign up for a noncredit course in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他想报名参加一个非学分的绘画课程。
words.en: Register for an educational course that does not offer academic credit toward a degree.

words.tr: n. 注册许可；登记许可
words.ex: He needs permission to register for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他需要获得注册这门课程的许可。
words.en: Official approval to enroll in a course.

words.tr: adj. 应给的；预期的；到期的；
words.ex: The payment is due tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这笔款项明天应给。
words.en: If something is due at a particular time, it is expected to happen or be done at that time.

words.tr:
v. 评论；表达意见；
n. 评论；意见；
words.ex: He commented on the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: A comment is something that you say which expresses your opinion of something or which gives an explanation of it.

words.tr: v. 发表评论；作出评论；提出意见
words.ex: He make comment on the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: To express an opinion or observation about something.

words.ex: He had to rewrite his essay after the teacher gave feedback.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师给出反馈后不得不重写他的作文。
words.en: If someone rewrites a piece of writing such as a book, an article, or a law, they write it in a different way in order to improve it or because circumstances have changed.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.tr: phrase. 经过编辑的版本；修改后的版本
words.ex: He submitted the edited version of his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他提交了修改过的文章版本。
words.en: a version of a text or document that has been revised and corrected

words.tr: phrase. 最终稿；定稿（用于出版或印刷前的最后一个版本）
words.ex: He submitted the final copy of his essay yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天提交了论文的最终稿。
words.en: The final version of a document, ready for submission or publication.

words.tr: 短语动词. 提交最终稿；把最终的副本交上去
words.ex: He will hand in the final copy tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交最终稿。
words.en: To submit the completed and final version of a document or work.

words.tr: phrase. 最终格式；最后的排版形式
words.ex: He passed the final algebra exam.
words.ex_cn: 他通过了最终的代数考试。
words.en: The definitive or last version of a document, design, or arrangement.

words.ex: He looked at the catalog to find the book.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看目录来找那本书。
words.en: A catalog is a list of things, such as the goods you can buy from a particular company, the objects in a museum, or the books in a library.

words.tr: phrase. 设计方案；设计规划
words.ex: He made a design plan for the new house.
words.ex_cn: 他为新房做了一个设计计划。
words.en: A detailed scheme or strategy for achieving a specific objective.

words.tr: phrase. 草拟；停住；逼近；追上；整队
words.ex: He will draw up a plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会起草一个计划。
words.en: To prepare and write something such as a document or plan, or to bring a vehicle to a stop.

words.tr: phrase. 参考书区；参考资料部分；文献引用部分
words.ex: He checked the reference section for the book.
words.ex_cn: 他去参考文献区查找那本书。
words.en: The part of a library where reference materials, such as encyclopedias and dictionaries, are kept for in-library use only.

words.tr: adj. 固定的日期；确定的日期
words.ex: The meeting has a fixed date.
words.ex_cn: 会议有一个固定的日期。
words.en: A specific, unchanging day or time set for an event or action.

words.ex: His submission to the boss ended the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 他对老板的屈服结束了这场冲突。
words.en: The act of submitting something to someone for their decision or consideration; the state of being submissive or obedient.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.tr: phrase. 小组项目；团体作业
words.ex: Our group project on renewable energy sources received high praise from our professor.
words.ex_cn: 我们关于可再生能源的小组项目得到了教授的高度赞扬。
words.en: A group project is a task or assignment that requires a group of people to work together to complete it. It often involves collaboration, division of tasks, and collective responsibility for the outcome.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.tr: n. 相当重的负荷；沉重的负担
words.ex: He has quite a heavy load of homework this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周有相当多的作业。
words.en: A significant amount of weight or burden, often more than expected or manageable.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.tr: 短语. 学分被授予；信用被给予
words.ex: Credit is awarded when you pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试时会获得学分。
words.en: Recognition or reward is given, often for work completed or achievements.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.ex: He earned a bachelor's degree in biology.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了生物学学士学位。
words.en: A bachelor's degree is an undergraduate academic degree awarded by colleges and universities upon completion of a course of study lasting three to seven years (depending on institution and academic discipline).

words.ex: His attendance at the meeting was mandatory.
words.ex_cn: 他必须出席这次会议。
words.en: The act of being present at a place or event.

words.ex: I misse somebody's lecture yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天错过了某人的讲座。

words.tr: phr. 告诉我详情；让我了解情况
words.ex: Can you fill me in on the meeting?
words.ex_cn: 你能告诉我会议的内容吗？
words.en: To provide someone with information that they were previously unaware of, especially details about a situation or event.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.ex: He put a note on the bulletin board.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张便条贴在公告栏上。
words.en: A bulletin board is a board on a wall which notices can be pinned to.

words.tr: n. 学校公告；校方发布的通知或简报
words.ex: The school bulletin lists the homework for today.
words.ex_cn: 学校公告栏列出了今天的作业。
words.en: An official publication from a school providing news, announcements, and information.

words.tr: phrase. 社区中心；为社区居民提供活动、服务和资源的公共场所
words.ex: The children play basketball at the community center.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在社区中心打篮球。
words.en: A community center is a place where people in a community can meet for social, educational, or recreational activities.

words.tr: phrase. 在……方面薄弱的；不擅长的
words.ex_cn: 他不擅长数学，但语言能力很强。
words.en: To lack strength or proficiency in a particular area.

words.tr: phrase. 争分夺秒地赶时间；与时间赛跑
words.ex: She was rushing against the clock to finish her project before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 她争分夺秒地在截止日期前完成她的项目。
words.en: To work or move quickly in order to complete something before a deadline or time limit.

words.tr: phrase. 遇到问题；陷入困境；遭遇麻烦
words.ex: We might run into problems if we don't plan carefully.
words.ex_cn: 如果我们不仔细计划，可能会遇到问题。
words.en: To encounter difficulties or issues.

words.ex: He faced a dilemma: stay home or go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困境：是待在家里还是去上班。
words.en: A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially equally undesirable ones.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.tr: phrase. 艰难的决定；棘手的抉择
words.ex: Making a tough decision can be very stressful.
words.ex_cn: 做一个艰难的决定可能会非常紧张。
words.en: A difficult choice that requires careful consideration and often involves conflicting options or outcomes.

words.ex: He will consult a doctor for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他将咨询医生治疗他的头痛。
words.en: to seek information or advice from someone, especially someone who is an expert in a particular field

words.ex: The police opened an enquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An enquiry is a question you ask in order to get some information.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.tr: n. 技术与技能；技巧与能力
words.ex: He learned basic techniques and skills from his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他从老师那里学到了基本的技巧和技能。
words.en: Methods and abilities used to perform tasks effectively.

words.tr: n. 导师的批准；顾问的同意
words.ex: He needs the advisor's approval to change his major.
words.ex_cn: 他需要导师的批准才能换专业。
words.en: The formal consent or authorization given by an advisor, typically required before proceeding with a plan or decision.

words.ex: He asked his teachers for letters of recommendation.
words.ex_cn: 他请老师给他写推荐信。
words.en: Formal documents that attest to a person's character or abilities.

words.tr: adj. 严格的；缜密的；严密的；
words.ex: The teacher is rigorous about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业截止日期要求严格。
words.en: If you are rigorous in something, you are very thorough and strict in the way you do it.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.tr: n. 需求；要求；必要条件；
words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.ex: The ticket is your admission to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这张票是进入音乐会的许可。
words.en: An admission is a statement in which you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, or the act of allowing someone to enter a place or organization.

words.ex: He walks to class on campus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行到校园上课。
words.en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.ex: He starts his new class in the fall semester.
words.ex_cn: 他在秋季学期开始他的新课程。
words.en: A semester is one of the two periods that the school or college year is divided into, especially in the United States and Canada.

words.tr: n. 奖学金；助学金；学术研究奖学金；同伴关系
words.ex: She received a full scholarshipfellowship to study abroad.
words.ex_cn: 她获得了一个全额奖学金去国外学习。

words.tr: n. 必修写作课；规定必须参加的写作课程
words.ex: He must take a required writing course this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这个学期必须上一门必修的写作课。
words.en: A compulsory writing class that is a requirement for a degree or program.

words.ex: The art class is optional for all students.
words.ex_cn: 美术课对所有学生都是选修的。
words.en: A class that students can choose to take as part of their curriculum, but is not mandatory.

words.tr: phrase. 预科课程；预备课程
words.ex: He took a preparatory course before starting university.
words.ex_cn: 他在上大学之前参加了一个预备课程。
words.en: A preparatory course is a course that prepares students for a particular exam or course of study.

words.ex: I took an introintroduction course last semester.
words.ex_cn: 我上学期上了一门入门介绍课程。

words.ex: He got the job because of his previous experience.
words.ex_cn: 他因为之前的经验得到了这份工作。
words.en: Previous experience refers to the knowledge or skill that someone has acquired from past events or activities.

words.tr: v. 修读先修课程（指在学习某门课程前必须完成的课程）
words.ex: He must take the prerequisite before enrolling in calculus.
words.ex_cn: 他在选修微积分之前必须先修完先修课程。
words.en: To complete a required prior course before taking a more advanced one.

words.ex: He will submit his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会提交他的作业。
words.en: To yield or surrender (oneself) to the will or authority of another.

words.ex: He wrote his name on a sheet of paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在一张纸上写了名字。
words.en: A sheet is a large piece of thin cloth used on a bed to lie on or under. It can also refer to a flat, thin piece of material, such as paper, metal, or glass.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.tr: phrase. 软拷贝；电子副本（指存储在计算机或数字设备中的文件，而非纸质打印版本）
words.ex: Please send me the soft copy of the report via email.
words.ex_cn: 请通过电子邮件发送给我报告的软拷贝。
words.en: A soft copy is an electronic version of a document or data, as opposed to a printed, physical copy.

words.tr: phr. v. 稍后回来查看；回访确认
words.ex: I will check back tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天再来看看。
words.en: To return to a place, person, or situation at a later time to see if there are any changes or updates.

words.tr: phrase. 正式培训；系统性的学习或训练过程，通常在教育机构或专业环境中进行
words.ex: The company provides formal training for new employees to ensure they understand the company's policies and procedures.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供正式培训，以确保他们理解公司的政策和程序。
words.en: Formal training refers to the structured and systematic process of learning and development, often provided by an educational institution or a professional organization, aimed at imparting specific skills, knowledge, and competencies.

words.ex: He got a driver's license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A license is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.tr: phrase. 学分课程（指修读后可获得学分的正式课程）
words.ex: He is taking a credit course in math.
words.ex_cn: 他正在修一门学分课程，内容是数学。
words.en: A credit course is a class that counts towards a degree or diploma, with the number of credits reflecting the course's workload and the level of study.

words.tr: phrase. 基础课程；为进入正式学习阶段前打基础的预备课程
words.ex: He is taking a foundation course in math.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上一门数学基础课程。
words.en: A foundation course is a course that provides basic knowledge and skills in a particular subject, often as preparation for further study.

words.tr: phrase. 中级课程；中等水平课程
words.ex: He is taking an intermediate course in math.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上一门中级数学课程。
words.en: A course of study or training that is between beginner and advanced levels.

words.ex: He is taking an advanced course in math.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上一门高级数学课程。
words.en: A course designed for students who already have a good understanding of the basic concepts and are ready to tackle more complex or specialized topics.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.ex: The inter-library loan system allows students to borrow books from other libraries.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆间借阅系统允许学生从其他图书馆借书。

words.tr: phrase. 视频库；影像资料库
words.ex: He borrowed a movie from the video library.
words.ex_cn: 他从视频图书馆借了一部电影。
words.en: A collection of videos that are available for viewing or borrowing, often organized in a systematic way.

words.tr: phrase. 在地下室；在底层；在基础部分
words.ex: The kids are playing in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在地下室玩耍。
words.en: A lower level of a building, often used for storage or utilities.

words.tr: phrase. 资料室；参考阅览室
words.ex: He went to the reference room to find a book.
words.ex_cn: 他去参考室找一本书。
words.en: A room in a library or other institution where reference materials such as books, journals, and encyclopedias are kept and can be consulted.

words.tr: phrase. 参考书库；参考文献架
words.ex: I need to go to the reference stacks to find a book.
words.ex_cn: 我需要去参考书库找一本书。

words.tr: phrase. 前台；接待处（通常指酒店、办公楼等的接待服务台）
words.ex: He asked the front desk for a new key.
words.ex_cn: 他向前台要了一把新钥匙。
words.en: The reception area of a hotel, office, or other establishment where guests are received.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.tr: phrase. 贷款柜台；银行办理贷款业务的窗口
words.ex: He stood at the loan counter to ask for money.
words.ex_cn: 他站在贷款柜台前询问借钱的事。
words.en: A place in a bank or financial institution where loans are processed and given to customers.

words.tr: phrase. 借阅期；贷款期限；借出期间
words.ex: The loan period for books is two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的借阅期是两周。
words.en: The duration for which something, especially a book from a library, is borrowed.

words.tr:
n. 返回；归还；
v. 返回；归还；
words.ex: The return of the train was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 火车的返回被推迟了。
words.en: To go or come back to a place or person. To give, send, or put something back to its original place or condition.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.ex: The photocopier broke down this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这台复印机今天早上坏了。
words.en: A photocopier is a machine that makes copies of documents or pictures by photographing them.

words.tr:
adj. 很好的；晴朗的；健康的；
n. 罚款；
words.ex: She did a fine job on the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上做得很好。
words.en: If you say that something is fine, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.ex: The hotel adds a charge fee for late check-out.
words.ex_cn: 酒店对延迟退房加收费用。
words.en: A charge fee is a payment demanded for services or goods provided.

words.tr: n. 学者；[复数]（院校的）学术活动；学者( academic的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The academics published a new research paper.
words.ex_cn: 这些学者发表了一篇新的研究论文。
words.en: Academics refers to the scholarly activities of a school or educational institution, especially the pursuit of research, education, and scholarship.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.tr: phrase. 文献综述；文献回顾
words.ex: He wrote a literature review for his research paper.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的研究论文写了一篇文献综述。
words.en: A literature review is a survey of scholarly sources on a specific topic. It provides an overview of current knowledge, allowing you to identify relevant theories, methods, and gaps in the existing research.

words.tr: phrase. 报纸评论；报刊评论文章
words.ex: He reads newspaper reviews every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸上的评论。
words.en: Critical evaluations or articles about a book, film, or performance published in newspapers.

words.tr: phrase. 当代的；同时期的 n. 评论；回顾
words.ex: The movie got good contemporary reviews.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影获得了当时的好评。
words.en: Reviews written at or near the time of a work's release or publication.

words.ex: He bought a paperback novel at the bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本平装小说。
words.en: A paperback is a book with a thin cardboard or paper cover, as opposed to a hardback, which has a hard cover.

words.ex: He uses an electronic book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子书来阅读。
words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.ex: The library has a collection of the rare books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆收藏了一些稀有书籍。

words.ex: He wears gloves to keep his hands warm.
words.ex_cn: 他戴手套来保暖双手。
words.en: Gloves are pieces of clothing which cover your hands and wrists and have individual sections for each finger. You wear gloves to keep your hands warm or dry or to protect them.

words.tr: phrase. 封面；书本或杂志的前面外页
words.ex: The book has a red front cover.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的封面是红色的。
words.en: The outermost page of a book, magazine, or brochure, which often displays the title, image, and other key information.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 2^3 中 2 的指数是 3。
words.en: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

words.tr: n. 文学指南；文学导读；文学手册
words.ex: He reads a literature guide to understand the novel.
words.ex_cn: 他读一本文学指南来理解这部小说。
words.en: A resource that provides guidance on relevant academic or scientific publications.

words.tr: phrase. 参考指南；参考手册
words.ex: You can use this reference guide to find information quickly.
words.ex_cn: 你可以使用这本参考指南快速找到信息。

words.tr:
adj. 抽象的；非具体的；
n. 摘要；概要；抽象派艺术作品；
words.ex: The painting shows an abstract shape.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了一个抽象的形状。
words.en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: The school stores student records in a database.
words.ex_cn: 学校将学生记录存储在数据库中。
words.en: A database is a collection of data that is organized so that it can easily be accessed, managed, and updated.

words.tr: phrase. 已发表与未发表的数据
words.ex: The researcher used published and unpublished data to find the truth.
words.ex_cn: 研究人员使用了已发表和未发表的数据来寻找真相。
words.en: Information that has been formally released to the public and data that has not.

words.tr: phrase. 新生入学指导；学生迎新活动
words.ex: The student orientation helps new students find their classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 新生入学指导帮助新生找到他们的教室。
words.en: An event or program designed to introduce new students to a school or university, its services, and its policies.

words.ex: Wear a helmet as a precaution when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔作为一种预防措施。
words.en: A precaution is an action that is intended to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant from happening.

words.tr: n. 商品；货物（merchandise 的复数形式，指各种待售物品）
words.ex: The store sells many merchandises like T-shirts and mugs.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售许多商品，比如T恤和马克杯。
words.en: Goods or products that are bought and sold in commerce.

words.tr: phrase. 商店信用额度；店内购物凭证（可用于下次消费，通常代替现金退款）
words.ex: He used store credit to buy a new shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他用店铺积分买了一件新衬衫。
words.en: Store credit is a credit that a store gives you when you return goods, which you can use to buy other goods from the store.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.tr:
n. 撤退；退却；静居处；
v. 撤退；退却；
words.ex: The army ordered a retreat after the battle.
words.ex_cn: 战斗后，军队下令撤退。
words.en: If you retreat, you move away from something or someone, often because you are frightened or because you want to be alone. A retreat is also a quiet, isolated place that you go to in order to rest or to do things in private.

words.ex: The government changed its education policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府改变了它的教育政策。
words.en: A policy is a set of ideas or plans that is used as a basis for making decisions, especially in politics, economics, or business.

words.ex: He got a full refund for the broken phone.
words.ex_cn: 他因为坏了的手机得到了全额退款。
words.en: A full refund is the return of the entire amount of money paid for a product or service, typically due to dissatisfaction or defect.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: She buys organic food at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上购买有机食品。
words.en: Food produced without the use of chemical fertilizers, pesticides, or other artificial chemicals.

words.ex: He likes to eat deep fried food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃油炸食品。

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.ex: The waitress brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waitress is a woman who works in a restaurant, serving food and drink to customers.

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.ex: I ate a fresh salad for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了一份新鲜的色拉。
words.en: A salad is a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, cucumber, and tomatoes, often served with a dressing.

words.ex: He lives off campus near the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校外，靠近公交车站。
words.en: Off campus refers to activities or locations that are situated away from the university or college grounds.

words.tr:
n. 通勤；
v. 通勤；
words.ex: His daily commute takes an hour by train.
words.ex_cn: 他每天的通勤坐火车要一个小时。
words.en: If you commute, you travel a long distance every day between your home and your place of work.

words.ex: Students join campus activities to make friends.
words.ex_cn: 学生参加校园活动来交朋友。
words.en: Events and organizations for students at a school or university.

words.ex: The school made an announcement about the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 学校发布了关于假期的通告。
words.en: A public or formal notice about something that has happened or is going to happen.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.tr: n. 飞行员; 飞行物; 飞鸟( flyer的名词复数 ); 飞跳
words.ex: He handed out flyers for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了音乐会的传单。
words.en: Small handbills or leaflets advertising an event or product.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.tr: phrase. 健身卡；健身房会员卡
words.ex: I bought a gym card.
words.ex_cn: 我买了一张健身卡。

words.tr:
n. 请求；要求的事；
v. 要求；请求；
words.ex: He made a request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个帮助的请求。
words.en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.tr: n. 顾问；咨询师；法律顾问；
words.ex: He asked his counselor for advice about his future.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的顾问咨询了关于未来的问题。
words.en: A counselor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their personal problems.

words.ex: The department secretary answers phone calls and files papers.
words.ex_cn: 部门秘书接电话并整理文件。
words.en: A department secretary is an administrative professional who supports the management of a department by performing clerical and organizational tasks.

words.ex: He checks his bank account every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天检查他的银行账户。
words.en: A bank account is an arrangement by which a bank holds money on behalf of a customer, who can deposit and withdraw funds.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.ex: He uses a credit card to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他用信用卡买食物。
words.en: A credit card is a small plastic card that you use to buy things on credit or to borrow money.

words.ex: He paid the deposits for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了公寓的押金。
words.en: 1. A sum of money placed or kept in a bank account, usually to gain interest. 2. A layer or body of accumulated matter.

words.tr: n. 付薪水的支票；薪水
words.ex: He gets his paycheck every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A paycheck is a check that an employee receives from their employer as payment for their work.

words.ex: The company updated the payroll last Friday.
words.ex_cn: 公司上星期五更新了职工工资册。
words.en: A payroll is a list of employees and the amount of money they are to be paid, or the total amount of money paid to the employees of a company.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.ex: He sent the document by fax.
words.ex_cn: 他通过传真发送了文件。
words.en: A fax is a machine that sends and receives documents electronically along a telephone line, or a document that is sent or received using such a machine.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.tr:
n. 桌子；表格；台子；
v. 搁置；
words.ex: He put his books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: A table is a piece of furniture with a flat top that you put things on or use to do things such as eat, write, or work.

words.ex: The teacher showed a chart of temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张温度图表。
words.en: A chart is a graphical representation of data, in which the data is represented by symbols, such as bars in a bar chart, lines in a line chart, or slices in a pie chart.

words.ex: The dean gave a speech at the graduation ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 院长在毕业典礼上发表了演讲。
words.en: A dean is a senior official in a college or university, who is in charge of a faculty or department or a group of students.

words.tr: phrase. 系主任；部门负责人
words.ex: The department chair speaks to students every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 系主任每周一和学生谈话。
words.en: The person who is in charge of a department in a college or university, responsible for its administration and academic programs.

words.ex: The chairperson spoke at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 主席在会议上发言。
words.en: A chairperson is the person in charge of a meeting, committee, or organization.

words.tr: 短语动词. 注册参加；登记入学；加入（课程、学校等）
words.ex: He will enroll in English class next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将报名参加英语课。
words.en: To officially register or join a course, program, or institution.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.ex: He is taking a basic course in math.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上一门基础数学课程。
words.en: A basic course is an introductory course that covers the fundamental aspects of a subject.

words.ex: Students must take foundational classes before advanced courses.
words.ex_cn: 学生在学习高级课程之前必须上基础类课程。

words.tr: phrase. 入门课程；基础课程；导论课
words.ex: He is taking an introductory course in math.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上一门数学入门课程。
words.en: An introductory course is a basic level course designed to introduce students to a subject or field of study.

words.ex: I am taking the intermediate level course this semester.
words.ex_cn: 这学期我上中级课程。

words.tr: phrase. 野外工作；实地考察
words.ex: The biologists did field work in the rainforest.
words.ex_cn: 生物学家在雨林中进行了野外工作。
words.en: Field work refers to practical work conducted by a researcher in the natural environment, rather than in a laboratory or office.

words.tr: phrase. 现场调查研究；田野调查
words.ex: He did field research in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他在丛林中进行了实地研究。
words.en: Field research refers to the collection of raw data outside a laboratory, library, or workplace setting. The approaches and methods used in field research vary across disciplines but generally involve direct observation, interviews, and participation in the activities of the community being studied.

words.ex: He submitted his academic record to the university.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的学业成绩提交给了大学。
words.en: A document that provides a detailed account of a student's academic performance, including grades, courses taken, and degrees awarded.

words.tr: phrase. 平均成绩；平均学分绩点（GPA），用于衡量学生学业表现的平均分数
words.ex: Her grade point average was high enough to qualify for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 她的平均绩点足够高，有资格获得奖学金。
words.en: A grade point average is a number representing the average value of the accumulated final grades earned in courses over time.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.ex: The tuition for this course is $500.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的学费是500美元。
words.en: Tuition is the fee charged for instruction, especially at a college, university, or private school.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 财政援助；经济资助
words.ex: He got financial aid to pay for his books.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了经济援助来支付书本费用。
words.en: Financial aid refers to funding intended to help students pay education expenses including tuition, books, and living costs for study at post-secondary educational institutions.

words.tr: phrase. 毕业表格；用于办理毕业手续的正式文件
words.ex: He filled out the graduation form last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周填了毕业表格。
words.en: A document required to complete academic studies or a course.

words.ex: He has met all the graduation requirements for his degree.
words.ex_cn: 他已经满足了他学位的所有毕业要求。

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.ex: Please verify your email address.
words.ex_cn: 请核实你的电子邮件地址。
words.en: To verify something means to check or prove that it is true, accurate, or justified.

words.ex: Please write your mailing address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的邮寄地址写在表格上。
words.en: The address to which mail is to be sent.

words.ex: The facilities manager ordered new lights for the office.
words.ex_cn: 设施经理为办公室订购了新灯具。

words.ex: The language lab manager helps students with listening exercises.
words.ex_cn: 语言实验室经理帮助学生进行听力练习。

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.ex: He works on an advisory committee.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个顾问委员会工作。
words.en: An advisory is a report or announcement that gives advice or information about a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 服务；
v. 保养；
words.ex: The restaurant offers excellent service.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅提供出色的服务。
words.en: The act of helping or doing work for someone; a system that provides something the public needs, such as transport, communications, or utilities.

words.ex: He is a freshman at university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的一名新生。
words.en: A freshman is a student in the first year of high school, college, or university.

words.ex: He is a sophomore at Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的二年级学生。
words.en: A sophomore is a student in the second year of college or high school.

words.tr:
adj. （职位或等级）较低的；年幼的；（高中、大学的）三年级学生；
n. 年幼者；
words.ex: He is a junior employee in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里职位较低的员工。
words.en: A junior person is younger or has a lower position than another person.

words.ex: The seniors gave us advice about how to succeed in school.
words.ex_cn: 前辈们给了我们关于如何在学校取得成功的建议。
words.en: Seniors are people who are older or of a higher rank than others in a particular group or organization.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.ex: He asked his professor for a recommend letter.
words.ex_cn: 他请求教授写一封推荐信。
words.en: A written statement endorsing someone's abilities or character, often for a job or school application.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: The employer gave her a raise.
words.ex_cn: 雇主给她加了薪。
words.en: An employer is a person or organization that employs people, paying them for their work.

words.tr:
v. 做实习生；扣留
n. 实习生
words.ex: He is interning at a hospital this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天在医院做实习生。
words.en: An intern is someone who works in a temporary position with an emphasis on on-the-job training rather than merely employment, often to gain experience in a particular field.

words.ex: The school invited its alumni to the annual reunion.
words.ex_cn: 学校邀请了它的校友参加年度聚会。
words.en: Alumni are former students of a particular school, college, or university.

words.ex: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划下个月招聘新员工。
words.en: To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to persuade someone to join a company, organization, or group.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: He went to a job fair to find work.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加招聘会找工作。
words.en: A job fair is an event where employers, recruiters, and schools give information to potential employees.

words.ex: He wears a suit to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天上班都穿西装。
words.en: To dress in a formal outfit consisting of a jacket, trousers, and often a tie, typically for professional or ceremonial occasions.

words.tr:
n. 公司；商行；
adj. 坚固的；结实的；
words.ex: He works for a small firm in London.
words.ex_cn: 他在伦敦一家小公司工作。
words.en: If something is firm, it does not change much in shape when it is pressed but is not completely hard. A firm is an organization which sells or produces something or which provides a service which people pay for.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: The corporation sells smartphones worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司向全球销售智能手机。
words.en: A corporation is a large company or group of companies that is controlled together as a single organization.

words.ex: The advancement of technology helps people live better.
words.ex_cn: 技术的进步帮助人们生活得更好。
words.en: The process of promoting a cause or plan; the act of moving forward or making progress.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在大厅里集合。
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.ex: He lives in the dorm with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dorm is a large building at a college or university where students live.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.tr:
v. 合唱；异口同声地说
n. 合唱团；合唱
words.ex: They chorus when the song reaches the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 当歌曲进行到桥段时，他们一起合唱。
words.en: A chorus is a part of a song which is repeated after each verse, or a group of people who sing together.

words.ex: The choir sings every Sunday in church.
words.ex_cn: 唱诗班每周日在教堂唱歌。
words.en: A choir is a group of people who sing together, especially in a church or school.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: The actors had a rehearsal before the play.
words.ex_cn: 演出前，演员们进行了一次排练。
words.en: A rehearsal of a play, dance, or piece of music is a practice of it in preparation for a performance.

words.ex: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的建筑花了两年时间。
words.en: The process or method of building or making something, especially buildings, bridges, etc.

words.tr:
n. 请求；要求的事；
v. 要求；请求；
words.ex: He made a request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个帮助的请求。
words.en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.

words.tr:
n. 视频；录像；
adj. 视频的；录像的；
words.ex: I watched a short video on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我看了一个YouTube上的短视频。
words.en: A recording of moving visual images made digitally or on videotape.

words.ex: The climbers reached the summit of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 登山者到达了山顶。
words.en: The highest point of a hill or mountain; a meeting between heads of government.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.ex: Children develop faculties for learning quickly.
words.ex_cn: 儿童发展出快速学习的能力。
words.en: The abilities or powers possessed by a person, especially those of the mind; the teaching staff of a university or college, or of one of its departments.

words.tr: phrase. 住房办公室；负责管理或分配住房的机构
words.ex: The housing office assists residents with their housing applications.
words.ex_cn: 房屋管理处协助居民处理住房申请。
words.en: An office that deals with matters related to housing, such as leases, maintenance, and tenant issues.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.ex: He will retire next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将退休。
words.en: If you retire, you stop working, usually because you have reached a certain age or because you are ill.

words.ex: People lived in the stone age before they made metal tools.
words.ex_cn: 在人们制造金属工具之前，人们生活在石器时代。
words.en: The Stone Age is a broad prehistoric period during which stone was widely used to make implements with a sharp edge, a point, or a percussion surface. The period lasted roughly 3.4 million years, and ended between 8700 BCE and 2000 BCE with the advent of metalworking.

words.ex: Paleolithic people used stone tools.
words.ex_cn: 旧石器时代的人使用石器。
words.en: The Paleolithic period is the earliest part of the Stone Age, preceding the Mesolithic and Neolithic periods.

words.ex: The Paleolithic period is known for the development of the first stone tools.
words.ex_cn: n. 旧石器时代以发展出第一批石器而闻名。
words.en: The Paleolithic period, also known as the Old Stone Age, is a prehistoric period of human history distinguished by the development of the first stone tools.

words.tr: phrase. 旧石器时代（指人类最早使用打制石器的史前时期）
words.ex: The Old Stone Age is known for the development of the first stone tools by humans.
words.ex_cn: n. 旧石器时代以人类首次发展出石器工具而闻名。
words.en: The Old Stone Age refers to the prehistoric period characterized by the use of stone tools, spanning from about 2.5 million years ago until around 10,000 years ago.

words.tr:
n. 中石器时代（旧石器时代与新石器时代之间的时代）
adj. 中石器时代的
words.ex: The Mesolithic people used small stone tools.
words.ex_cn: 中石器时代的人们使用小型石器。
words.en: The Mesolithic period, or Middle Stone Age, is an archaeological term describing specific cultures that fall between the Paleolithic and the Neolithic periods.

words.ex: People in the Neolithic age used stone tools.
words.ex_cn: 新石器时代的人们使用石器。
words.en: Relating to or denoting the later part of the Stone Age, when ground or polished stone weapons and implements prevailed.

words.ex: The neolithic periodage was a time when humans learned to farm.
words.ex_cn: 新石器时代是人类学会农耕的时期。

words.tr: phrase. 新石器时代（约公元前10000年至公元前2000年，以磨制石器和农业出现为特征）
words.ex: People in the new stone age used stone tools to hunt animals.
words.ex_cn: 新石器时代的人们用石器狩猎动物。
words.en: Another name for the Neolithic period, the later part of the Stone Age when humans began farming and living in permanent settlements.

words.ex: People lived in the bronze age thousands of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 几千年前，人们生活在青铜时代。
words.en: The Bronze Age is a period characterized by the use of bronze, proto-writing, and other early features of urban civilization.

words.ex: The Iron Age is characterized by the widespread use of iron tools and weapons.
words.ex_cn: 铁器时代的特点是广泛使用铁制工具和武器。
words.en: A historical period characterized by the use of iron tools and weapons, following the Bronze Age.

words.ex: The archeologist digs old pots in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 考古学家在沙漠中挖掘古老的陶器。
words.en: An archeologist is a person who studies the buildings, graves, tools, and other objects of people who lived in the past.

words.ex: The ruins show the antiquity of this civilization.
words.ex_cn: 这些废墟展示了这个文明的古老。
words.en: The ancient past, especially the period before the Middle Ages.

words.ex: The ancient civilization built big pyramids.
words.ex_cn: 这个古代文明建造了巨大的金字塔。
words.en: An ancient civilization refers to a society that has reached an advanced stage of social development and organization, often characterized by significant achievements in culture, technology, and governance, existing in the distant past.

words.ex: They buried him in a grave tomb.
words.ex_cn: 他们把他埋在一个坟墓里。

words.tr: n. 毁灭；废墟；“ruin”的复数； v. 毁灭；破坏；
words.ex: The war left the city in ruins.
words.ex_cn: 战争使这座城市化为废墟。
words.en: The remains of a building, city, etc., that has been destroyed or is in a state of decay.

words.tr:
v. 剩下；留下；依然不变；
n. 遗迹；残余；遗体；
words.ex: Only two cookies remains on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌上只剩下两块饼干了。
words.en: The parts left over after other parts have been removed, used, or destroyed.

words.ex: This historicalrelic was found in an old temple.
words.ex_cn: 这件历史文物是在一座古老寺庙中发现的。
words.en: A historical relic is an object or building that is surviving from the past and is of historical interest.

words.ex: The museum protects many cultural relics.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆保护许多文物。
words.en: Cultural relics are objects that have survived from the past, especially ones of historical or cultural interest.

words.ex: The old temple is a relic from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙是来自古代的遗迹。
words.en: An object surviving from an earlier time, especially one of historical or sentimental interest.

words.tr:
adj. 古老的；
n. 古董；
words.ex: He bought an antique chair from the old market.
words.ex_cn: 他从旧市场买了一把古老的椅子。
words.en: Something that is antique is old and often valuable because it is rare or well made.

words.tr: n. 人工制品；手工艺品；加工品
words.ex: The museum has an ancient artifact.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一件古代文物。
words.en: An artifact is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon, a common utensil.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起了一把勺子，一种常见的餐具。
words.en: An utensil is a tool that you use in your home, especially in the kitchen, for example, a knife, fork, or spoon.

words.tr: phrase. 烹饪用的容器；用于加热或储存食物的器皿
words.ex: A cooking container is essential for preparing meals.
words.ex_cn: 烹饪容器是准备饭菜的必需品。
words.en: A vessel or utensil, such as a pot or pan, used for preparing and cooking food.

words.ex: He paddles a canoe on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他划着独木舟在湖上航行。
words.en: A canoe is a small, narrow boat that you move through the water using a paddle.

words.ex: The ancient tool was made of obsidian.
words.ex_cn: 这个古代工具是由黑曜石制成的。
words.en: Obsidian is a naturally occurring volcanic glass formed as an extrusive igneous rock.

words.tr:
adj. 秘密的；隐蔽的
n. （动物可藏身的）小树丛
words.ex: He made a covert plan to leave without telling anyone.
words.ex_cn: 他秘密制定了一个不告诉任何人就离开的计划。
words.en: Covert activities or situations are secret or hidden.

words.ex: They bury the dead in the cemetery.
words.ex_cn: 他们把死者埋葬在墓地里。
words.en: To bury something means to put it into a hole in the ground and cover it up, often in order to hide it or to put it to rest.

words.ex: Workers excavate the old ruins with shovels.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用铲子挖掘古代遗址。
words.en: To excavate means to dig in the ground in order to find things that have been buried there, such as archaeological remains.

words.ex: They unearthed an old coin in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他们在花园里挖出了一枚旧硬币。
words.en: To unearth something means to find it by digging in the ground or to discover something that was hidden or unknown.

words.ex: The excavation revealed ancient pottery.
words.ex_cn: 挖掘发现了古代陶器。
words.en: The process of digging up and removing earth, especially at an archaeological site.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: Prehistory is the time before writing was invented.
words.ex_cn: 史前是文字发明之前的时代。
words.en: The period of time before written records began, studied through archaeology and anthropology.

words.tr: phrase. 古罗马（指古罗马文明或古罗马帝国）
words.ex: Ancient Rome had many big temples and roads.
words.ex_cn: 古罗马有许多巨大的神庙和道路。
words.en: The civilization and empire centered in Italy, known for its advanced engineering, law, and military from the 8th century BC to the 5th century AD.

words.tr: phrase. 古希腊的；指古希腊语言或文化的
words.ex: He studied Ancient Greek literature in college.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里学习了古希腊文学。
words.en: The civilization of ancient Greece, renowned for its contributions to philosophy, art, science, and democracy from the 8th to the 1st century BC.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.ex: He traveled to Europe last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了欧洲。
words.en: Europe is one of the world's seven continents, comprising the westernmost peninsula of Eurasia. It's known for its rich history, diverse cultures, and significant contributions to art, science, and politics.

words.ex: She was born in Britain.
words.ex_cn: 她出生在英国。
words.en: Britain is a country in Europe consisting of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland, known for its history, culture, and influence in the world.

words.ex: He visited Italy last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了意大利。
words.en: A country in southern Europe, known for its rich cultural heritage, history, art, and cuisine.

words.ex: He visited Rome last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了罗马。
words.en: The capital city of Italy, known for its rich history, architecture, and as the center of the Roman Catholic Church.

words.tr:
adj. 希腊的；
n. 希腊语；
words.ex: He loves eating Greek food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃的希腊食物。
words.en: Relating to Greece, its people, or their language.

words.ex: He visited Egypt last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了埃及。
words.en: A country in northeastern Africa, known for its ancient civilization and monuments such as the pyramids.

words.ex: He lives in France.
words.ex_cn: 他住在法国。
words.en: A country in western Europe, known for its cultural heritage, including art, fashion, and cuisine.

words.ex: He lives in germany.
words.ex_cn: 他住在德国。
words.en: Germany is a country in Central Europe. It is bordered to the north by the North Sea, Denmark, and the Baltic Sea; to the east by Poland and the Czech Republic; to the south by Austria and Switzerland; and to the west by France, Luxembourg, Belgium, and the Netherlands.

words.ex: He lives in Spain.
words.ex_cn: 他住在西班牙。
words.en: Spain is a country located in southwestern Europe on the Iberian Peninsula.

words.ex: We ate turkey for Thanksgiving dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节晚餐上吃了火鸡。
words.en: A turkey is a large bird that is often eaten at Christmas or Thanksgiving.

words.ex: He visited the Netherlands Holland last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天访问了荷兰。

words.ex: He lives in Canada.
words.ex_cn: 他住在加拿大。
words.en: Canada is a country in North America consisting of ten provinces and three territories. Located in the northern part of the continent, it extends from the Atlantic Ocean in the east to the Pacific Ocean in the west and northward into the Arctic Ocean.

words.tr: phrase. 拉什莫尔山（美国南达科他州的一座山，因雕刻有华盛顿、杰斐逊、林肯、罗斯福四位总统的巨大头像而闻名）
words.ex: Mount Rushmore attracts millions of visitors each year.
words.ex_cn: n. 拉什莫尔山每年吸引数百万游客。
words.en: Mount Rushmore is a famous landmark in the United States, located in the Black Hills of South Dakota. It features the 60-foot (18 m) sculptures of the heads of four United States presidents: George Washington, Thomas Jefferson, Theodore Roosevelt, and Abraham Lincoln.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.ex: The clergy prayed in the church every morning.
words.ex_cn: 神职人员每天早上在教堂祈祷。
words.en: The clergy are the official leaders of religious activities in certain religions, especially in Christianity.

words.tr: phrase. 基督教会；基督教教堂
words.ex: He goes to the christian church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日去基督教教堂。
words.en: A building used for Christian worship, typically with a congregation and a pastor or priest.

words.ex: The monks live in a quiet monastery.
words.ex_cn: 僧侣们住在一座安静的修道院里。
words.en: A monastery is a building or collection of buildings in which monks live and work.

words.ex: He reads from his prayer book every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从他的祈祷书里阅读。
words.en: A book containing prayers, hymns, and other religious texts used in Christian worship.

words.ex: The knight rode a horse and wore shiny armor.
words.ex_cn: 骑士骑着马，穿着闪亮的盔甲。
words.en: In the Middle Ages, a knight was a man of high social rank who had a duty to fight for his king. Knights are often depicted as noble warriors on horseback.

words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.ex: The cave man used stones to make tools.
words.ex_cn: 洞穴人用石头制作工具。
words.en: A prehistoric human, especially one from the Stone Age, often depicted as living in caves and using primitive tools.

words.tr: n. 游牧民；流浪者；游牧生活；流浪生活
words.ex: The nomad walks with his sheep across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 游牧民带着他的羊群穿越沙漠。
words.en: A nomad is someone who has no permanent home and moves according to the seasons from place to place in search of food, water, and grazing land.

words.ex: The clan lived in a small village for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这个氏族几个世纪以来一直住在一个小村庄里。
words.en: A clan is a group of families or relatives who are connected by blood or marriage and who often share the same surname.

words.ex: The tribe lives in the forest and follows old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在森林里，遵循古老的传统。
words.en: A tribe is a social division in a traditional society consisting of families or communities linked by social, economic, religious, or blood ties, with a common culture and dialect, typically having a recognized leader.

words.ex: The two countries formed an alliance to fight the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家结成联盟以对抗敌人。
words.en: An alliance is a group of countries or political parties that are formally united and working together because they have similar aims.

words.ex: The countries formed a federation to share resources.
words.ex_cn: 这些国家组成了一个联盟来共享资源。
words.en: A federation is a group of states or organizations that have joined together to form a single entity with a central government or authority.

words.ex: The mixture is homogeneous and looks the same throughout.
words.ex_cn: 这种混合物是均一的，看起来处处都一样。
words.en: Something that is homogeneous is uniform in nature or character throughout.

words.ex: The skull protects the brain.
words.ex_cn: 颅骨保护大脑。
words.en: The bony framework of the head that encloses the brain and supports the structures of the face.

words.tr: adj. 头盖的；颅骨的；颅的
words.ex: The doctor checked his cranial injury after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 医生在他摔倒后检查了他的颅骨损伤。
words.en: Relating to the cranium or skull.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: He practices his religion every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都实践自己的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religion is the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

words.tr: n. （宗教等的）仪式；例行习惯；
words.ex: The village holds a ritual every spring to pray for good weather.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄每年春天都举行一个仪式，祈求好天气。
words.en: A ritual is a religious service or other ceremony which involves a series of actions performed in a fixed order.

words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To originate means to have a specific beginning or to start something.

words.ex: Birds inhabit the forest near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类居住在湖边的森林里。
words.en: If a place or region is inhabited by a group of people or a species of animal, those people or animals live there.

words.tr: n. （通过模仿等传递的）文化基因
words.ex: The internet is full of memes that spread quickly.
words.ex_cn: 互联网上充满了传播迅速的模因。
words.en: A meme is an idea, behavior, style, or usage that spreads from person to person within a culture.

words.ex: Eating healthy food helps with longevity.
words.ex_cn: 健康饮食有助于长寿。
words.en: Longevity refers to the length or duration of an individual's life, especially when it is unusually long.

words.ex: The fecundity of the rabbits helped them grow quickly.
words.ex_cn: 兔子的高繁殖力帮助它们迅速增长。
words.en: The ability to produce an abundance of offspring or new growth; fertility.

words.ex: His fidelity to his friend never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: Fidelity is loyalty to a person, organization, or set of beliefs.

words.ex: The accuracy of the clock is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟的精确性很高。
words.en: The quality or state of being correct or precise.

words.ex: The anthropologist studies ancient tribes.
words.ex_cn: 这位人类学家研究古代部落。
words.en: An anthropologist is a person who studies anthropology, which is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: The paleoanthropologist digs ancient bones in Africa.
words.ex_cn: 这位古人类学家在非洲挖掘古代骨头。
words.en: A paleoanthropologist is a scientist who studies the origins and predecessors of the present human species, using fossils and other remains.

words.ex: He is an ecological anthropologist who studies how people live with nature.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位生态人类学家，研究人们如何与自然共存。
words.en: A scientist who studies the interactions between human cultures and their natural environments.

words.ex: He is a psychological anthropologist who studies how culture affects the mind.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位心理人类学家，研究文化如何影响思维。
words.en: A specialist in anthropology who focuses on the study of human behavior, cognition, and mental processes within cultural contexts.

words.ex: The native american tribe lived near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这个美洲原住民部落住在河边。
words.en: A Native American is a member of any of the indigenous peoples of the Americas.

words.tr: adj. （男性）家长制的；族长制的；父权制的
words.ex: He lives in a patriarchal family where the father makes all the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在一个父亲做所有决定的父权家庭中。
words.en: Relating to, characteristic of, or denoting a system of society or government controlled by men.

words.ex: He loves visiting museums to see fine art.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢去博物馆欣赏艺术。
words.en: Fine art refers to creative art, especially visual art whose products are to be appreciated primarily or solely for their imaginative, aesthetic, or intellectual content.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.tr: phrase. 艺术学院；美术学院
words.ex: He goes to an art academy to learn painting.
words.ex_cn: 他去艺术学院学习绘画。
words.en: An institution where students study and practice fine arts, such as painting, sculpture, and graphic design.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.ex: He works in a small studio near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一个小工作室工作。
words.en: A studio is a room where an artist, photographer, or designer works, or a place where movies or television programs are made.

words.tr: n. 美容院；美发厅；沙龙
words.ex: She goes to the salon to get her hair cut.
words.ex_cn: 她去理发店剪头发。
words.en: A salon is a gathering of people under the roof of an inspiring host, held partly to amuse one another and partly to refine the taste and increase the knowledge of the participants through conversation.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.ex: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.ex_cn: 见面时握手是一种习俗。
words.en: A convention is a large meeting of an organization or political group, or a way of behaving that is considered to be correct or polite by most people in a society.

words.tr: phrase. 文艺复兴（欧洲14至16世纪的文化运动）
words.ex: The renaissance brought new art and ideas to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 文艺复兴为欧洲带来了新的艺术和思想。
words.en: The Renaissance was a period in European history, covering the span between the 14th and 17th centuries and marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity. It is characterized by a revival of interest in classical learning and wisdom, and the development of new artistic and scientific techniques.

words.tr: phrase. 当代艺术；指当前时代创作的艺术作品，通常指20世纪中叶至今的艺术形式和流派
words.ex: He visits the museum to see contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 他去博物馆看当代艺术。
words.en: Contemporary art refers to art produced at the present period in time. Contemporary art includes, and develops from, Postmodern art, which is itself a successor to Modern art.

words.tr: phrase. 部落艺术；指由原住民或部落社会创作、具有文化与仪式意义的传统艺术形式
words.ex: The museum displays tribal art from Africa.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了来自非洲的部落艺术。
words.en: Art created by indigenous or traditional communities, often reflecting cultural symbols and practices.

words.ex: He paints abstract art for fun.
words.ex_cn: 他为了乐趣画抽象艺术。
words.en: Art that does not attempt to represent reality accurately, instead using shapes, colours, and forms to achieve its effect.

words.tr:
adj. 先锋的；前卫的
n. 先锋派；前卫
words.ex: The artist uses avant-garde styles in her paintings.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家在她的画作中使用前卫的风格。
words.en: Avant-garde is used to describe people or works that are experimental or innovative, particularly in the arts.

words.ex: The movie shows realism by depicting everyday life honestly.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影通过真实地描绘日常生活展现现实主义。
words.en: Realism is the quality or fact of representing a person, thing, or situation accurately or in a way that is true to life.

words.ex: He loves impressionism in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢绘画中的印象派。
words.en: Impressionism is a style or movement in painting originating in France in the 1860s, characterized by a concern with depicting the visual impression of the moment, especially in terms of the shifting effect of light and color.

words.tr: phrase. 印象派风格；印象主义风格
words.ex: The painting uses an impressionistic style with bright colors.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画使用了印象派风格，色彩鲜艳。
words.en: A style in art, music, or literature that seeks to capture a feeling or experience rather than to achieve accurate depiction.

words.ex: He likes dadaism because it is strange and wild.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢达达主义，因为它奇怪而狂野。
words.en: Dadaism was an art movement of the European avant-garde in the early 20th century, with early centers in Zürich, Switzerland, at the Cabaret Voltaire (circa 1916). Dadaists rejected the logic, reason, and aestheticism of modern capitalist society, instead expressing nonsense, irrationality, and anti-bourgeois protest in their works.

words.ex: The building has a neoclassical style with white columns.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑有着带有白色柱子的新古典主义风格。
words.en: Neoclassical refers to a revival of classical styles or influence in art, literature, architecture, or music.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.tr: adj. 极简派风格的；受极简主义影响的；
words.ex: She lives in a minimalist apartment with only essential furniture.
words.ex_cn: 她住在一间只有必需家具的极简派风格公寓里。
words.en: A minimalist is someone who likes to keep things very simple, with no decoration or unnecessary details. In art, minimalism is a style that uses simple shapes and avoids unnecessary detail.

words.ex: The bicycle was a precursor to the car.
words.ex_cn: 自行车是汽车的先驱。
words.en: A precursor is something that happened or existed before another thing, especially if it either developed into it or had an influence on it.

words.tr: n. 装饰船头的人像；傀儡领袖；有名无实的首脑；
words.ex: The old ship had a wooden figurehead of a lion.
words.ex_cn: 那艘旧船的船头有一个木制的狮子像。
words.en: A figurehead is a person who is the head of an organization or country in name only, without any real power or authority.

words.ex: The critic praised the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位评论家称赞了这部新电影。
words.en: A critic is a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, films, music, etc.

words.tr:
n. 业余爱好者；
adj. 业余的；
words.ex: He is an amateur who paints on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他是个周末画画的业余爱好者。
words.en: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby and not as a job.

words.ex: He loves creating oil painting on canvas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在画布上创作油画艺术。
words.en: An oil painting is a picture that has been painted using oil paints.

words.tr: phrase. 水彩画，水彩，水彩画技艺
words.ex: He paints with water color on paper.
words.ex_cn: 他用水彩在纸上绘画。
words.en: A painting technique using pigments suspended in water, typically applied with brushes to paper or other surfaces.

words.tr: n. 版画； v. 在（硬物）上雕刻；“engrave”的现在分词；
words.ex: He bought an old engraving at the art market.
words.ex_cn: 他在艺术市场买了一幅古老的版画。
words.en: An engraving is a picture or design that has been cut into a surface.

words.ex: The ancient mural painting fresco is well preserved.
words.ex_cn: 这幅古老的壁画保存完好。

words.tr: phrase. 洞穴艺术；史前人类在洞穴墙壁上绘制的图画或雕刻
words.ex: Ancient people drew cave art on rock walls.
words.ex_cn: 古人在岩壁上绘制洞穴艺术。
words.en: Artistic works made by prehistoric people, typically found in caves, using pigments from natural materials.

words.tr: phrase. 炭笔画；用炭笔绘制的素描作品
words.ex: She spent hours perfecting her charcoal drawing of the landscape.
words.ex_cn: 她花了几个小时来完善她的风景素描。
words.en: A drawing made with charcoal, a form of carbon used for drawing, known for its deep black color and ability to create a wide range of tones.

words.tr:
n. 草图；素描；概述
v. 草拟；速写；简述
words.ex: He made a quick sketch of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他快速画出了房子的草图。
words.en: A sketch is a simple, quickly-made drawing that does not have many details. It can also mean a short description or account of something.

words.tr:
n. 漫画；讽刺画；滑稽模仿
v. 画成漫画讽刺
words.ex: He drew a caricature of the teacher with big eyes.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅老师大眼睛的漫画。
words.en: A caricature is a drawing or description of someone that exaggerates their appearance or behavior in a humorous or critical way.

words.ex: The animator brought the characters to life with vivid colors and movements.
words.ex_cn: 动画师用生动的颜色和动作赋予了角色生命。
words.en: An animator is a person who creates animated films or cartoons.

words.ex: He saw a beautiful panorama from the mountain top.
words.ex_cn: 他从山顶看到了美丽的全景。
words.en: A panorama is a view of a wide area, or a description or study that presents all the different parts or aspects of a particular subject.

words.ex: He practices calligraphy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习书法。
words.en: Calligraphy is the art of producing decorative handwriting or lettering with a pen or brush.

words.tr: n. 雕刻（术）；雕塑品；雕刻品；
words.ex: He made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土做了一件精美的雕刻。
words.en: Sculpture is the art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.

words.ex: There is a big statue in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 城市中心有一座巨大的雕像。
words.en: A statue is a large sculpture of a person or an animal, made of stone or metal.

words.tr:
n. 半身像；胸部；搜捕
v. 打碎；搜捕
adj. 破产的；打碎的
words.ex: The museum has a marble bust of the ancient king.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一座古代国王的大理石半身像。
words.en: A bust is a sculpture of a person's head, shoulders, and chest. As a verb, to bust means to break something, to arrest someone, or to go bankrupt.

words.ex: The sculptor carved a statue from stone.
words.ex_cn: 这位雕刻家从石头中雕刻出一座雕像。
words.en: A sculptor is an artist who creates sculptures.
